newsitem.title: FRANCE: UAP shares rise on results, profits.
newsitem.headline: UAP shares rise on results, profits.

text.p: Shares in French insurer UAP jumped in morning trading after it reported a rise in first-half profits and said 1996 would be the year it returned to lasting profitability.
The stock was 3.93 percent up at 0819 GMT at 111.2 francs, while the CAC-40 leading share index was up 0.1 percent.
UAP reported a first-half net attributable profit of 860 million francs on Wednesday, versus 806 million last time round.
It said it expected a second-half result similar to the first half and a return to lasting profitability.
The 6.7 percent first-half profit rise was helped by a 14.4 percent rise in insurance profits.
In 1995 the group reported a loss of 2.065 billion francs after an exceptional charge of 4.5 billion francs.
